literal: Revenue having increased, wealth having developed, the obstacles that arise he who investigates, let him do the work.
translation: Let the person who can increase revenues, develop prosperity, and foresee and investigate the obstacles that may arise, perform the task.
modern: வருவாயைப் பெருக்கி, வளத்தை உண்டாக்கி, வரக்கூடிய இடையூறுகளை ஆராய்ந்து நீக்க வல்லவனே அந்தச் செயலைச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualifications of an agent chosen to execute a task. The ideal person must be capable of increasing the sources of revenue (வாரி பெருக்கி) and developing overall prosperity and resources (வளம்படுத்து). Crucially, they must also have the foresight to anticipate, analyze, and resolve any obstacles or difficulties that may arise during the execution of the work (உற்றவை ஆராய்வான்). Only a person possessing these three capabilities should be entrusted with performing the task (செய்க வினை).
